description: This file implements network information handling, including adapter enumeration, IP address modification, route management, and network interface status querying for both Windows and POSIX systems. It contains classes and functions to interact with system network interfaces, retrieve adapter details, and manage network routes, with platform-specific code sections.
external_files: <POSIX-specific headers: arpa/inet.h, ifaddrs.h, net/if_arp.h, rtnetlink.h, list, net/if.h, netinet/in.h, sys/ioctl.h, sys/socket.h>

classes.name: IPNode
classes.description: Represents an IP address node, supporting IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, with methods for address manipulation and host address retrieval.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: Represents a network interface, providing methods to query and modify interface state, addresses, and routes.

classes.name: AdapterIterator
classes.description: Iterates over network adapters, providing access to adapter properties such as name, MAC address, and status.

classes.name: AdapterObserver
classes.description: Observes network adapter events and status changes, allowing registration and unregistration of notification callbacks.

classes.name: RoutingTable
classes.description: Represents the system routing table, capable of retrieving and managing network routes.

classes.name: IPNetworks
classes.description: Singleton class managing the collection of network interfaces and their addresses, supporting platform-specific netlink or Windows API interactions.

methods.name: ConvertMACToString
methods.description: Converts a MAC address byte array to a string representation with delimiters.

methods.name: LoadAdapterInfo
methods.description: Loads network adapter information for a given adapter index, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: Address
methods.description: Returns the IP address as a string.

methods.name: HostAddress
methods.description: Returns the host address string of an IPNode.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an IP address to the network interface.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes an IP address from the network interface.

methods.name: Gateway
methods.description: Sets a gateway for a network.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates network interface properties based on netlink or Windows API data.

methods.name: IsUp
methods.description: Checks if the network interface is up.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the network interface is running.

methods.name: Up
methods.description: Enables or disables the network interface.

methods.name: Broadcast
methods.description: Sets the broadcast address for the interface.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a callback for network adapter events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a callback for network adapter events.

methods.name: RequestStatus
methods.description: Requests current network interface status updates via netlink or Windows API.
